cover.sub: ALL 17 STREAKS + THE NUKE · KILLS · UNLOCK LEVEL

streaks.name: UAV
streaks.desc: Reveals enemies on the minimap. Launch buff: health 100 → 150.

streaks.name: Bomb Glider
streaks.desc: Hand-flown glider with an explosive payload.

streaks.name: Care Package
streaks.desc: Drops a crate with a random killstreak.

streaks.name: Impact Warhead
streaks.desc: Explosive payload that drills through multiple floors.

streaks.name: Artillery Beacon
streaks.desc: Heat-seeking missiles track the beacon you throw.

streaks.name: Crossfire
streaks.desc: Two airstrikes hit from opposite directions.

streaks.name: Wheelson
streaks.desc: AI vehicle that hunts nearby enemies or guards you. Reworked at launch to be more aggressive.

streaks.name: Missile Salvo
streaks.desc: Aerial platform that fires lock-on missiles.

streaks.name: Railgun Sentry
streaks.desc: Autonomous railgun sentry that fires flechette rounds.

streaks.name: Attack Helicopter
streaks.desc: Circles overhead and tracks targets for your team.

streaks.name: Deathstalker
streaks.desc: Remote-controlled heli with twin turrets. Watch the overheat.

streaks.name: Advanced UAV
streaks.desc: Shows enemy facing direction live. Can't be locked on.

streaks.name: Argonaut
streaks.desc: Heavy armor suit with a cluster grenade launcher and burst-fire sidearm.

streaks.name: Air Lockdown
streaks.desc: Series of bombing runs plus extra anti-air cover. Last streak you unlock.

streaks.name: Tactical Nuke
streaks.desc: 30 kills in ONE life. Only gun, equipment and field upgrade kills count. Ends the match: your team wins.

rules.title: HOW STREAKS WORK
items: One streak per kill tier. Saved per class: every loadout can run its own streaks.
Capturing a flag, holding the Hardpoint or planting the Data Spike also fills your streak meter.
Perk 2, level 4: every streak costs 1 kill less.
Perk 1, level 48: kills from your streaks give half streak points.
Your streak counter goes back to zero when you die.
